{{- /* [CAP:encrypt] → see caps/encrypt/manifest.json Password resolution (page → parent → site), matching Foundry encryptAESGCM + decrypt.js. "HTML" | default "" -}} {{- else -}} {{- $html = .Content -}} {{- end -}} {{- $password := "" -}} {{- $level := "" -}} {{- $path := "" -}} {{- if $page.Params.password -}} {{- $password = $page.Params.password -}} {{- $level = "page" -}} {{- $path = $page.RelPermalink -}} {{- else if $page.Parent -}} {{- if $page.Parent.Params -}} {{- if $page.Parent.Params.password -}} {{- $password = $page.Parent.Params.password -}} {{- $level = "parent" -}} {{- $path = $page.Parent.RelPermalink -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- if not $password -}} {{- if $page.Site.Params.password -}} {{- $password = $page.Site.Params.password -}} {{- $level = "site" -}} {{- $path = "/" -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- if $password -}} {{- if not $html -}}{{- $html = "" -}}{{- end -}}
{{- partial "encrypt-modal.html" $page -}} {{- else -}} {{- $html | safeHTML -}} {{- end -}}
